content: Nu Yahwedi yahehewe tinambek yoŋa adi’walaŋkade bulat. Kaŋ du tububuyebe tiŋa bagi niŋdi momoŋ tiŋa ulak wendok tuwot momoŋ kweboboe foloŋ lowit yo nanilaŋ?
Biyagoŋ hinek, me hogohi adi me didimehi yalamdok mambip gineŋ tebe kaŋgumahik sumuyeyekeeŋ tebesithik hamane-dindineeŋ woomyemiiŋ.
Metam hogohogokdi titiŋ fofohi biyabudapmaune metam didimehi adi dediŋ buyo tineŋ?
Yahwe adi Siloŋyot uŋgoniŋ gineŋ hatak. Adi yadi kunum gineŋ Mapme loloŋnit ilaŋa kwetkwet metam hogohogokdi maŋgoŋ tiiŋ u ila kanadidapmalak.
Yahwe adi me didimehi be me hogohi wanakaŋ yabunadi tilak. Tiŋa metam Yodoko Medeŋiŋ sigilulum timiiŋdok adi weleŋdi yabukwihita hinek tilak.
Wendoktiŋa tuwahik diniŋ kibikoŋ kudup-mebem ime dabugoŋ kwatneune fooŋ me hogohi u yehidalak.
Yahwe ne adi titiŋ didimeniŋ hogok tilak. Unduŋ doktiŋa metam didimehi adi yabukahile hinek tilak. Ale metam nediyeŋ Bepaŋ’walaŋ medeŋiŋ takalineeŋ adi yadi namanda kaneeŋ.
